WITH shares AS (
  SELECT 
    f.rating,
    COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rented_count,
    COUNT(r.rental_id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental r2 JOIN inventory i2 ON r2.inventory_id = i2.inventory_id JOIN film f2 ON i2.film_id = f2.film_id) AS share_pct
  FROM rental r 
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id 
  JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id 
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share_pct) AS avg_pct FROM shares
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    rented_count,
    share_pct,
    (SELECT avg_pct FROM avg_share) AS avg_pct
  FROM shares
  WHERE share_pct > (SELECT avg_pct FROM avg_share)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(rented_count) AS combined_rented,
  AVG(share_pct) AS average_share,
  AVG(share_pct - avg_pct) AS avg_above_average
FROM above_avg
